landing.hero_subtitle: The cultural rally of the Colonial Zone
landing.what_body: Turizoneando is a digital educational game experience that works from any web browser. Participants visit historic sites of the Colonial Zone, scan a QR code at each stop, listen to a narrated story, and answer questions to win prizes.
landing.cta_body: Join the most exciting cultural rally in the Colonial Zone.

register.title: Join the rally!
register.subtitle_2: Tell us a bit about you
register.rules_body:
To participate in the cultural rally you must:
• Visit each stop and scan the QR code.
• Listen to the narrated story of each site.
• Answer the questions correctly.
• Prizes are validated based on age and availability.
• One registration per email address.
register.accept: I accept the rules and participation conditions
register.must_accept: You must accept the rules to continue
register.fill_all: Please fill in all required fields
register.err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

map.no_prizes_sub: Complete rally stops to earn prizes
map.app_desc: Turizoneando is a digital cultural gamification experience that connects tourists and citizens with the historic heritage of the Colonial Zone of Santo Domingo.
map.privacy_data_body: We collect your name, email address, country of origin, and in-app progress. We do not share your personal information with third parties.
map.privacy_location_body: Location is used only to show your position on the interactive map and calculate routes to rally stops. It is not stored permanently.
map.terms_use_body: By using Turizoneando you agree to participate in the rally under the established rules. The app is valid only within the Colonial Zone of Santo Domingo.
map.terms_prizes_body: Prizes are valid based on their expiry date and the availability of the participating establishment. One prize per stop, per registered user. Non-transferable.
